App 只做「显示器 + 键盘」，pi 始终跑在电脑上，: The app is just a screen + keyboard; pi always runs on your computer,
pi 记的价，不是我们按价目表算的: Prices recorded by pi itself, not estimated from a list
provider 与 Key 都要填: Both provider and key are required
「已切换到 xxx」如实显示出来（见无人值守那一项）。: shows “switched to xxx” honestly (see unattended mode).
下次会话启动时不再连接它。: It will not be connected on next launch.
今天 / 本月（本机全部会话）: Today / this month (all sessions on this machine)
会执行 git worktree remove ${wt.path}。目录里有未: Runs git worktree remove {path}. git refuses if there are uncommitted changes.
先打开一条会话才能切模型: Open a session first to switch models
先打开一条会话才能改思考等级: Open a session first to change thinking level
关掉的代价是：从锁屏切回来之前，跑完/卡住/需要确认这些提醒都收不到。: Cost of turning it off: until you switch back, no finished / stuck / needs-input alerts.
出门在外（4G / 别的 WiFi）也能连上这台电脑。局域网连接不受影响。: Reach this computer from anywhere (4G / another Wi-Fi). LAN connections are unaffected.
卡住提醒（多久没新输出就提醒）: Stall alert (notify after this long without output)
压缩后还没跑过模型，暂无法估算: No model run since compaction, cannot estimate yet
发送失败：通知被系统拦了: Send failed: the system blocked the notification
启动后本页点「扫描局域网」就能直接找到这台电脑；: After starting, tap “Scan LAN” to find this computer;
命令清单还在拉取…（未连接或服务端没返回时，这里会一直是空的）: Loading command list… (stays empty when not connected)
图片会跟这条消息一起发给 pi；其他文件先传到工作区，再把路径写进输入框。: Images go with the message; other files are uploaded first, then their paths are inserted.
在浏览器打开上面的地址，输入设备码：$code: Open the URL above in a browser and enter device code: {code}
在电脑上启动服务端: Start the server on your computer
在电脑上启动服务端的终端里能看到「配对码: 6 位数字」，填进来即可。: The server terminal shows “pairing code: 6 digits” — enter it here.
它在后台的作用：SSE 长连接不被冻结、「卡住」提醒的定时器照跳。: What it buys: the SSE connection is not frozen and the stall timer keeps ticking.
将删除 $provider 在 pi 里保存的凭据。删掉后该 provider: Deletes the credential stored for {provider} in pi. Its models become unavailable.
已关闭后台保活（更省电，但切回 App 前收不到提醒）: Background keep-alive off (saves battery, no alerts until you switch back)
